verdict.rationale: Maritime is built for agent-driven operation: its CLI is designed to be run by other AI agents, with JSON output, stable exit codes and non-interactive key auth. Agents can also be provisioned idempotently through the SDK, messaged with a wait-for-reply, and given per-user micro-VMs or Linux desktops whose disk can be read through the Files API. However, these are long-lived agent environments rather than an ephemeral code-execution sandbox, and nothing documents running arbitrary code and getting stdout back directly. Missing for 10: a direct code-execution/exec API returning output, documented teardown or delete of the provisioned environment, ephemeral sandbox semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.
